subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter and specific control evidence
messages:
From: Jason Liu <jason.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter and additional control artifacts

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As part of Acme Health's supplier risk review we need the following: 

- SOC 2 Type II report covering the 10/01/2024 – 09/30/2025 audit period (PDF)
- If the report doesn't fully cover our contract start date, a signed bridge letter that explicitly extends the coverage or explains gaps
- Evidence for controls related to authentication and access:
  - MFA enforcement policy and proof of rollout (dated)
  - Sample authentication logs showing successful/failed MFA events (CSV or syslog excerpts) for Jan 2026 (a small sample is fine)
  - Quarterly privileged access review results for Q4 2025 and the remediation/exception tracker
  - A timestamped audit/logging sample demonstrating retention and immutability for login events

Could you also confirm the audit period your SOC 2 report covers and whether there were any bridge letters or exceptions issued after the report date? We have a tight vendor committee deadline and would ideally need the artifacts by EOD 3/3/2026.

If you prefer a secure transfer link or a DPA/DocuSign envelope for sensitive files, let us know.

Thanks,
Jason Liu\Security and Risk\Acme Health

Attachment: vendor_request_form.pdf (PDF stub)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter and additional control artifacts

Folks — forwarding Acme's ask. They want SOC 2 + bridge letter (if applicable) and specific control evidence: MFA policy/rollout proof, sample MFA logs (Jan), Q4-2025 access review outputs, and an example of login/event retention. Deadline EOD 3/3.

Rishi — can you pull the SOC 2 PDF and the signed bridge letter (we issued one 2026-01-31 for the gap in coverage if I recall)?
Laura — can you export a redacted slice of MFA auth logs (Jan 2026) and provide the quarterly access review CSV for Q4 2025. They asked for remediation/exception tracker too — attach any open items.

Plan: we upload to a secure share (pre-signed link) and provide a DocuSign envelope for the bridge letter. We should strip PII from logs; provide only event metadata (timestamp, actor-id-hash, event-type, success/failure).

Notes: keep the sample size small (they said samples are ok). If you need additional sign-off for sharing logs, loop in Legal/Security.

Thanks — Steph\Director, Sales Operations\Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Jason Liu <jason.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter and additional control artifacts

Thanks, Stephanie — that sounds good. A couple of clarifications:

- For the bridge letter, a signed PDF is fine.
- For logs, CSV with the columns (timestamp, event_type, user_hash, source_ip, outcome) is ideal. Please redact any user-identifiable fields and replace with stable hashes.
- For access review evidence, a CSV with reviewer, review_date, resource_scope, decision (ok/revoke), and notes is perfect.

If you can provide the secure share link and a short README listing which files are redacted and what was removed, that will speed our review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Jason

Attachment: none

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Jason Liu <jason.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter and additional control artifacts

Jason — thanks for the clarity. We collected the requested items and uploaded them to a secure folder. See transfer link and a quick index below.

Secure share: https://redwood-secure-share.example.com/edge/AcmeHealth/2026-02-28 (expires 3/10/2026)
DocuSign envelope: 0a1b2c3d-ACME-ENV-4567 (bridge_letter_20260131.pdf signed)

Included files (redacted where noted):
- redwood_soc2_type2_20241031.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report, audit period 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30)
- bridge_letter_20260131.pdf (signed bridge letter describing coverage extension for 2025-10-01 to 2026-01-31)
- mfa_policy_v2.docx (policy document with enforcement date)
- mfa_auth_logs_jan2026_sample.csv (redacted: user_id hashed, IP truncated, retained event metadata)
- access_review_Q4_2025.csv (reviewer, date, scope, decision, notes)
- remediation_tracker_Q4_2025.xlsx (open items and closure dates)
- readme_acme_evidence.txt (explains redaction and sample selection)

We redacted direct usernames and replaced them with stable hashes; IP addresses are truncated to /24; timestamps are intact. If you need raw logs under a DPA with additional controls, we can coordinate Security & Legal for a constrained transfer.

Let us know if the artifacts meet your committee's needs or if you want any expanded samples.

Best,
Steph

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_20241031.pdf (PDF stub), bridge_letter_20260131.pdf (PDF stub), mfa_auth_logs_jan2026_sample.csv (CSV stub), access_review_Q4_2025.csv (CSV stub)
